title: Share native context graph views across CLI, MCP and HTTP
goal: Vision: V-2. Share repeated public graph presentation and ingestion without changes to the storage owner, paid protocol, observability, replay or standalone behavior.

reuse.searched: Shared native workspace events, resource-scoped ingestion, compaction, OS sample reports, blocking HTTP dispatch and existing tool defaults. Compared Sovereign RAG context_store_v1 and both frontends. Retained independent native graph and history ownership.
